name: Overcrowded
steps: Remove the gold watch from the girl.
Remove the cotton pad from the child.
Remove the jeans from the child.
Remove the thermal band from the child.
Remove the stockings from the child.
Remove the hair from the man wearing the white shirt.
Take the sweet potato from the housewife’s basket and give it to the man in the lower left.
Take the glasses from the man wearing the blue shirt.
Open the toolbox and take the scissors.
Use the scissors to open the cardboard box.
Remove the stone from the box.
Use the crowbar to remove the woman’s yellow skirt.
Remove the man’s mask to complete the level.
The elevator will now be light enough to move to the next floor.
